channel.title: New Relic Monitor
channel.description: Application updates for New Relic Monitor

item.title: Version 2.3.0
item.description:
What's New in v2.3.0

Two New Relic-native additions to the entity detail view, plus the per-entity alert suppression fix from v2.2.0.

Errors (last hour)

  • APM detail views now list grouped application errors by class and message, with occurrence counts
  • Top 10 error groups ranked by count, with a header chip showing the total

Recent Deployments

  • APM detail views now show change-tracking deployment markers from the last 30 days
  • Each entry shows version, time, author, and a deep link into New Relic when available

Also included

  • Alert suppression now works per-alert instead of globally (from v2.2.0)

No configuration changes required. All existing settings and API keys are preserved.

item.title: Version 2.1.0
item.description:
What's New in v2.1.0

Major internal improvements for stability, performance, and reliability since v1.9.2.

Architecture (v2.0.0)

  • API Client Refactor - NewRelicAPIClient reduced from 2,365 to ~500 lines; delegates to focused service classes
  • UI Performance - Fewer SwiftUI re-renders during searches and filter changes
  • Memory Management - Entity cache now enforces 5-minute TTL and 500-entry max with LRU eviction
  • Thread Safety - GraphQL rate limiting protected by NSLock; EntityService marked @MainActor
  • Error Visibility - All silent failures now log context for debugging

Service Hardening (v2.1.0)

  • Credential Handling - Safer nil/empty API key handling across all services
  • Notification Reliability - More robust permission checking and delivery
  • Dynamic Versioning - About window always shows the correct version
  • Expanded Tests - 690+ lines of new unit test coverage

No configuration changes required. All existing settings and API keys are preserved.

item.title: Version 1.9.1.4

item.title: Version 1.9.1.3
item.description:
What's New in v1.9.1.3

  • Notification Tests - Filtering, deduplication, muting, and sound behavior
